metadata.name: GetStatusDefinition
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to get the configuration for the mentioned status.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountStatus
request_fields.description: Credit Report Details Status Code Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xx Example: 12

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Specific ID Assigned to a Merchant, Mandatory If Merchant Number not Inputted in API Request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 562489

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: StatusDefinition
children.description: The list of parameters configured for mentioned status.

children.name: AccountID
children.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of CardNumber / AdminNumber / AccountNumber / AccountID is required.

children.name: StatusDescription
children.description: Description of status Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example: Active Allowable Values: 50

children.name: StatusPriority
children.description: Denotes Status priority Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX Example: 7 Condition: If request type  = 1 then priority can be set

children.name: SelfServiceAccess
children.description: Access to Self Service Portal Valid Values: Yes, No Format: XXX Example: No Condition: If request type  = 1 then priority can be set

children.name: IssueReissueAction
children.description: Action configured for Valid Values: 0 =Issue or Reissue 1 = Do not Issue or Reissue 2 = Do not Issue or Reissue and report Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: FinanceChargeAction
children.description: Action configured for Finance Charge Valid Values: 0 = Normal finance charge calculation 1 = Defer finance charge 2 = Waive finance charge Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: RevolvingPaymentAction
children.description: Action configured for Revolving Payment Valid Values: 0 = No effect 1 = Bill account for entire outstanding balance 2 = Cancel any outstanding deferments 3 = Skip payment Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: InsuranceCancellationAction
children.description: Action configured for Insurance Cancellation Valid Values: 	0 = No effect 1 = Cancel insurance; No block, reinstatement automatic 2 = Cancel insurance; Reinstatement will be manual Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: CreditBureauStatus
children.description: Description CBR of status Valid Values:Refer Appendix Format:XXXXXX Example: Active Allowable Values: 2

children.name: CheckOpenToBuy
children.description: Action configured for Check Open To Buy Valid Values: 0 = Do not Check OTB when posting purchases 1 = Check OTB when posting purchases Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: PostingOfTransactions
children.description: Action configured for Posting Of Transactions Valid Values: 	0 = Post normally 1 = Post normally and report 2 = Non post all transactions 3 = Non post all transactions, report on Reject Report 4 = Non post debits and report 5 = Non post debits 6 = Divert debits, post credits to Plan segment 7 = Non post transactions not defined for Charged-off accounts 8 = Non Post Purchases Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: LoyaltyPointsDeduction
children.description: Loyalty Points Deduction Method Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: LoyaltyPointsAccumulation
children.description: Loyalty Points Accumulation Method Valid Values: Refer Appendix Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: InsuranceEligibility
children.description: Configuration for Insurance Eligibility Valid Values: 0 = No - Not Eligible for Insurance Products 1 = Yes - Eligible For Insurance Products Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: PostingReason
children.description: Configuration for Posting Reason Valid Values:  Refer Appendix Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: HoldStatement
children.description: Configuration for Hold Statement Valid Values: 	1 = Print Statement 2 = Hold Paper Statement Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: WaiveLateChargeAction
children.description: Action configured for Waive Late Charge Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: WaiveLateChargeFor
children.description: Action configured for Waive Late Charge For Valid Values: Refer Appendix Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA Allowable Values: 2

children.name: WaiveLateChargeCyclesFrom
children.description: Configuration for Waive Late Charge Cycles From Valid Values: 1 = Account opening 2 = Previous cycle date 3 = Status Setting Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: WaiveAnnualFeeAction
children.description: Action configured for Waive Annual Fee Valid Values: 0 = No - Do not waive membership fees 1 = Yes - Waive membership fees Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: WaiveAnnualFeeActionFor
children.description: Action configured for Waive Annual Fee Valid Values: Refer Appendix Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: WaiveAnnualFeeActionCyclesFrom
children.description: Action configured for Waive Annual Fee Cycles From Valid Values: 1 = Account opening 2 = Previous cycle date 3 = Status Setting Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: WaiveOverlimitFeeAction
children.description: Action configured for Waive Over limit Fee Valid Values: 	0 = No - Do not waive overlimit fees 1 = Yes - Waive overlimit fees Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: WaiveOverlimitFeeActionFor
children.description: Action configured for Waive Over limit Fee Valid Values: Refer Appendix Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: WaiveOverlimitFeeActionCyclesFrom
children.description: Action configured for Valid Values: 1 = Account opening 2 = Previous cycle date 3 = Status Setting Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: WaiveInsufficientFundsAction
children.description: Action configured for Waive Insufficient Funds Valid Values: 0 = No - Do not waive NSF check charges 1 = Yes - Waive NSF check charges Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.description: Action configured for Waive Insufficient Funds Valid Values: Refer Appendix Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: WaiveInsufficientFundsActionCyclesFrom
children.description: Action configured for Waive Insufficient FundsCycles From Valid Values: 1 = Account opening 2 = Previous cycle date 3 = Status Setting Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: StatementDelivery
children.description: Configuration for Statement Delivery Valid Values: 0 = Mail to Account holder 1 = Mail to Merchant 2 = No Action Required Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: WaiveMinimumDue
children.description: Configuration for Waive Minimum Due Valid Values: 0 = Calculate Minimum Due and Age Delinquency 1 = Waive Minimum Due and Do NOT Age Delinquency 2 = Calculate Minimum Due and Do NOT Age Delinquency Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: WaiveMinimumDueFor
children.description: Configuration for Waive Minimum Due Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: WaiveInsurancePremiums

children.name: NegativeRewardBalanceToCharge
children.description: Configuration for Negative Reward Balance To Charge Valid Values: 1 = Clear Negative Points 2 = Clear Negative Points and Post Debit Transaction Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: TrigRewardRedemption
children.description: Configuration for Trig Reward Redemption Valid Values: 0 = No 1 = Yes Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: ExRedemptionMethod
children.description: Action configured for Ex Redemption Method Valid Values:  1 = ACH 2 = Credit Account 3 = Statement Credit 4 = Gift Certificate 5 = Partner Pay 6 = Manual Check 9 = Loan Pay Down Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: RetainGraceStatus
children.description: Action configured for Retain Grace Status Valid Values: 0 = No 1 = Yes Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: AfterNumberOfCycles
children.description: Configuration for After Number Of Cycles Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: COReasonCode
children.description: Configuration for Charge Off Reason Code Valid Values: 0 = None 1 = Credit Losses 2 = Bankruptcy 3 = Fraud 4 = Other 6 = Deceased 7 = Contarctual Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: NewManualStatus
children.description: Configuration for New Manual Status Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: InitiateChargeOffAtZeroBalance
children.description: Description: Indicates either initiating Charge Off at Zero or Negative Balance is allowed or not. Valid Values: Blank, 0 = No 1 = Yes Format: XX Example: 1

children.name: CardStatusAction
children.description: Configuration for CardStatusAction Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: PartnerStatusCateogry
children.description: Configuration for PartnerStatusCateogry Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PromoPlan
children.description: Configuration for PromoPlan Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: PromoPlanTurnOffMsg
children.description: Configuration for PromoPlanTurnOffMsg Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AlertSuppress
children.description: Configuration for AlertSuppress Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Allowable Values: 50

children.name: SendToFraud
children.description: Configuration for SendToFraud Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AllowDebitWriteOff
children.description: Configuration for AllowDebitWriteOff Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AllowCashTransaction
children.description: Allow Cash Transactions Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Allowable Values: 2

children.name: StatusDueToOptingOutOfPenaltyPricing
children.description: Indicates the status to be applicable on account if Penalty Pricing is Opted Out. Valid Values: ‘1’ = Yes when checkbox check and ‘0’ = No when checkbox uncheck Format: X Example: 0   Status due to Opting-Out of Penalty Pricing

children.name: IssuerFileUpdateProfile
children.description: Description:This field will hold the value set up in Issuer File Update Profile of Status Definition. Valid Values:  Integer values.(ID of the Profile) minLength: 0 maxLength: 6 Format: NNNN Example: 5000

children.name: NYMandateRewardRedemption
children.description: Description: Indicates if the 90-day Reward Redemption is allowed as per NY Mandate when account falls in the given status. Valid Values:  Integer values.(ID of the Profile) 0 = No 1 = Yes

children.name: StatusGroup
children.description: Configuration for Status Group Valid Values: Refer Appendix Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: ExcludeFromCBR
children.description: Configuration for Exclude From CBR Valid Values: 0 = No 1 = Yes Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: CBRSpecialComment
children.description: Configuration for CBRSpecialComment Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ComplianceConditionCode
children.description: Configuration for ComplianceConditionCode Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ConsiderasClosed
children.description: Description: Indicates if status is considered as Closed to populate the Date account closed. Valid Values: 1=Yes and 0=No Example: 0

children.name: SendToCollections
children.description: Configuration for Send account To Collections Valid Values: 0 = No - Not for this Status Code 1 = Yes - High Priority 2 = Yes - Low Priority 3 = Yes - Force 4 = No - Not for any Collection Reason Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: SetDunSuppress
children.description: Configuration for Set Dun Suppress Valid Values: 0 = No - Do not effect Dun suppress indicator 1 = Yes - Set Dun suppress indicator Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: RestructureActionCode
children.description: Action configured for Restructure Action Code Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: CloseCaseActionCode
children.description: Action configured for Close Case Action Code Format: XX Example: 1 Condition: NA

children.name: OverridePriority
children.description: Configuration for Override Priority Valid Values: 0 = No 1 = Yes Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: GenerateEmail
children.description: Configuration for Generate Email Valid Values: 0 = No 1 = Yes Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: GenerateSMS
children.description: Configuration for Generate SMS Valid Values: 0 = No 1 = Yes Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: GenerateLetter
children.description: Configuration for Generate Letter Valid Values: 0 = No 1 = Yes Format: XX Example: 2

children.name: AllowCustomerServiceReage
children.description: Will determine that Special Re-age to bypass the counter will be applicable or not on accounts associated with defined status. Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Example: 1

children.name: AccountActivationAllowed
children.description: will determine whether account activation process is allowed or not. Valid Values: 1-No,0-Yes Example: 0

children.name: AllowChangeInBillingCycle
children.description: This tag indicates either change in the billing cycle of the account is allowed or not. Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Example: 1

children.name: UpdateSameStatusForLinkedCustomerAccount
children.description: This tag indicates either status of all linked customer account should be updated or not. Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Example: 1

children.name: CustomerStatus
children.description: This tag indicates either status of all linked customer account should be updated or not. Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Example: 1

children.name: AllowNewAccountCreation
children.description: This tag indicates whether new account or application creation is allowed based on Customer Statuses on Linked Accounts. Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Example: 1

children.name: Allow1099CReporting
children.description: Determines if 1099C reporting is required at this status or not. Valid Values: 0 = No,1 = Yes Format: XX Example: 0

children.name: UpdateableFromCoreAdmin
children.description: This tag indicates that Coreadmin user is able to update status or not . Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Example: 1
